heroText: Commercial electrical contractors for Brisbane fitouts, base building works and data infrastructure.
introText: Successful fitouts are about far more than electrical installation. Every decision on site ripples across programme, landlord requirements, tenant expectations and practical completion. We work alongside builders, project managers and consultants to keep projects moving, from the first site meeting through to handover.
buildingsText:
Base building services, loading docks, lift bookings, after-hours protocols and tenancy standards change from tower to tower.
We've worked in most of them, so we hit the ground running instead of learning the building as we go. Here are just a few.
